subject: [PATCH 0/2] mm: refactor zonelist constructors and iterators

reviews.author: Balbir Singh
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch without any objections or suggestions.

2026-09-02.patch_summary: The patch refactors the zonelist constructors and iterators in the Linux kernel to make them more flexible and explicit. Specifically, it introduces a new function `find_next_best_node_in()` that takes an explicitly defined candidate set, and extracts the per-node construction loop from `build_zonelists()` into a separate function `build_node_zonelist()`. These changes allow for building zonelists over custom candidate sets and iterating them in fallback order. The patch is a refactoring effort with no functional change intended.
